transcript: That was not on the supply list. I have started a separate list. Let's listen before we move. Agreed. The road carries sound. This road used to mean safe passage. It can again. That is why we continue. I preferred counting things. You still count who gets home. Do I get a quieter job after this? You have not finished this one. Someone taught them to hold this road. The order survived its purpose. One moment, I'll check behind us. A sensible habit. Keep it. Funny, I didn't stop shaking. You moved anyway. I don't wanna get used to that. Then remember why you are here. Forward then, one problem at a time. One step is enough for now. Are you keeping count too? Only of the decisions that matter. Give me a moment before we go. Take it. Rushing is not recovery. That was closer than I'd planned. Find shelter before another fight. All right, a little less bravery. A little more distance would help. I could use that campfire now. A retreat can still be progress. Tell me that looked deliberate. I would prefer to be accurate. I used to know every turn here. Then we can learn what has changed. I keep reaching for a bag I lost. Old habits are slow to catch up. Do my questions ever tire you? Not yet. You may continue. You can talk without being asked. I was leaving room for your thoughts. Was it always this quiet here? You remember people. That is different. Who is still waiting out there? Someone may be asking that about you. Sage. That name suits you. It is sufficient. I will answer to it. A map never shows how a place feels. Someone must carry that part. If I sound calm, don't be fooled. I hear more than your tone. I used to worry about missing nails. You noticed what others overlooked. She really is keeping that lamp lit. She is making a place to return to. She spoke to me like I was a person. You still are. I didn't expect to miss ordinary talk. You do not have to stop having it. I wish I could promise her more. Return when you can. Start with that.
